'''Viya''' (Gheviya,<ref>typo "Gheviva" in Maho (2009)</ref> Eviya, Avias) is a minor [[Bantu language]] of [[Gabon]]. A collection of proverbs in their language has been published, with French translations.<ref>[http://www.ddl.ish-lyon.cnrs.fr/fulltext/Van%20Der%20Veen/Bodinga-bwa-Bodinga_1995_Van_der_veen.pdf Online collection of proverbs]</ref> Also, a bilingual dictionary has been compiled.<ref>VAN DER VEEN L. J. et S. BODINGA-BWA-BODINGA (2002), Gedandedi sa geviya, dictionnaire geviya-français. Collection « Langues et littératures de l’Afrique Noire (XII) dirigée par G. Philippson. Louvain – Paris – Sterling, Editions Peeters.</ref>
